name: Nemuri Hime no Nemuranu Yoru ni...
source: In the year 1339, an 18-year-old princess goes to sleep, and she fails to awaken for over six months.  Meanwhile, her father and brother are both killed at war, and the kingdom is on the verge of being conquered.  The main character is a curse specialist called in to awaken the sleeping beauty by the end of the summer solstice festival, one week away.  He decides to use whatever means possible to accomplish his goal...
translation: 1339年，一名18岁的公主陷入沉睡，六个多月都未能醒来。与此同时，她的父亲与兄长均在战争中丧生，王国也濒临被征服。主人公是一名受邀而来的诅咒专家，任务是在一周后的夏至庆典结束前唤醒睡美人。他决定不择手段地完成目标……
